paper_title: Axion and neutrino bounds improved with new calibrations of the tip of the red-giant branch using geometric distance determinations
notes: Tip of the red-giant branch (TRGB) stellar cooling bound on the axion-electron coupling using new geometric distance calibrations. Best (galactic) bound from omega Centauri: g_ae < 1.3e-13 (95% CL, g13 < 1.29 per Table I); cleanest extragalactic case NGC 4258 gives g_ae < 1.6e-13 (95% CL, g13 < 1.58). The reported limit is mass-independent (valid for axion masses well below the He-core temperature, ~10 keV); no explicit mass validity range is stated in the paper, so mass-0 sentinel rows are used. This is an astrophysical bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density assumption applies. Paper also constrains neutrino magnetic dipole moment (mu_nu < 1.2e-12 mu_B), not encoded here. | selector: text (sole candidate)
